title: Charge Master and the $0.00 claim guard

Navigate to /facility/{facility_uuid}/billing/charge-master.
The page opens with three tabs: Insurance Charges, Self-Pay Charges, Templates.
Insurance Charges: the per-unit price used when a claim is priced against an insurance payer. Self-Pay Charges: the per-unit price used when the patient is self-pay.
Templates: Superbill templates (fixed CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10 code lists) you attach to visit types.

claims.claim: This guard exists because on 2026-08-27, right before go-live, the biller-facing pricing path was reading the wrong dollar-amount key on the service line: the 837P builder wrote charge_amount, the reader looked for lineItemChargeAmount, and every claim went through with $0 lines. The whole prod set — 1,134 claims — priced at $0.

checks.note: would hold if the guard's record named 1,134 $0 claims

claims.finding: The guard's record (backend/supabase/functions/_shared/validateClaimLineCharges.ts:17-21) says 85 of 85 production service lines on 2026-08-26 carried no charge key at any spelling the transforms read (charge_amount / line_item_charge / charges / charge), so every line defaulted to 0 — not a charge_amount vs lineItemChargeAmount mismatch. 1,134 is the row count of the legacy DrChrono-import claims table (frontend/src/pages/__tests__/procureS2.deadBillingScreens.contract.test.ts:17), not a count of $0 claims.
claims.proposed_text: This guard exists because, checked on 2026-08-26 just before go-live, all 85 service lines on production carried no charge at any key the 837P transforms read, so every line defaulted to $0.
